name_reason: Compliant with data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=dialog, descriptor=portrait_blink_subtick_counter. Name reflects both the data type (a counter) and its role (the 2-call subtick divider for the talking-portrait blink animation). No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix tied to 0x53A14). Accurately matches the verified use in fd2_portrait_blink_animation_step.
purpose: 2-call subtick divider that gates the visible-frame update of the talking-portrait mouth animation in fd2_portrait_blink_animation_step.
logic_summary: fd2_portrait_blink_animation_step is called once per rendered glyph from fd2_display_dialog_scene while blink_flag is set. Each call increments this counter (INC [0x53A14]); when it reaches 2 (CMP [0x53A14],0x2) the frame counter at 0x53A10 advances (0->1->2->3->0, value 3 collapsed to 1 when painted) and this counter is reset to 0 (MOV [0x53A14],0). Net effect: the visible portrait frame updates once every 2 calls. Only three xrefs exist, all in fd2_portrait_blink_animation_step (0x164F2 READ_WRITE inc, 0x164F8 READ cmp, 0x16532 WRITE reset).
datatype: uint32 (accessed exclusively as dword ptr: INC / CMP imm / MOV imm; unsigned scalar)
element_semantics: Single unsigned 32-bit scalar holding the running subtick count (cycles 0/1 across calls). Not an array; not a flag; a plain divider counter.
notes: Memory at 0x53A14 reads all zeros (zero-init BSS); src defines it as `uint32 data_fd2_dialog_portrait_blink_subtick_counter;` with no static initializer, correctly matching. Game code both reads and writes it -> not const (correctly emitted as zero-init BSS, not const). Existing src comment block (dialog.c lines ~1272-1284) is already precise and accurate (verified claim-by-claim against disasm/decomp), so comment kept; no Edit to dialog.c. The data address had a blank Ghidra plate (PLATE=null), so a concise data plate was created via run_script_inline PLATE_COMMENT, consistent with the src conclusion; the function plate of fd2_portrait_blink_animation_step also documents this global and remains consistent. Paired global at 0x53A10 = data_fd2_dialog_portrait_blink_frame_idx (the frame counter).
